scope: Read-only final store/page/shell connection and original form audit; no build/GUI/enumeration or source/docs edits; current formal sources only, parent owns frozen build.

observations.name: final page replacement
observations.result: --printer-settings creates worker/page; removes final subpage3 placeholder, inserts same page once and restores prior subpage.

observations.name: readiness and store ownership
observations.result: Store moves to dedicated worker, initialization runs there; SHELL_READY requires printer success. Init failure exits3. No physical job or system-default change.

observations.name: busy/draft/navigation and identity
observations.result: Hidden printer busy blocks user-page switch, login, logout and normal close. Dirty draft requires keep/discard before accepted navigation/logout/close. Keeping draft cancels; discard restores committed name without write. Original no printer role gate preserved; no instrument readiness changes.

observations.name: save error and commit
observations.result: Only saved/loaded render committed snapshot. Errors leave draft and prior in-memory committed value; controls reenable. Dirty false disables no-op Apply; unavailable persisted name remains visible.

observations.name: form geometry
observations.result: Current .ui bytes exactly match original; C++ font adaptation and source QSS added without geometry change. Original active Windows visual comparison remains unverified.

observations.name: shutdown
observations.result: Queued blocking close then thread quit/wait, finished->deleteLater. CUPS enumeration remains synchronous and noncancelable; this audit does not claim bounded shutdown.

observations.name: build membership
observations.result: New page/store/shell/form enter qmake/native build and package feature metadata. Actual parent build/package outcomes not reviewed here.

finding.title: Successful save drops other accepted INI keys
finding.trigger: Start from any tagged printer.ini containing a non-printer/name key, initialize successfully, choose another available name, Apply.
finding.observed_code: readStored accepts unknown keys; writeStored creates an empty temporary INI and writes only schema/name, so successful atomic commit removes all other keys.
finding.impact: Breaks original setValue single-key preservation and prior contract recommendation. Dedicated file boundary narrows impact but accepted unrelated data is silently removed.
finding.suggested_minimal_action: Preserve expected original bytes into unique temporary before QSettings edits, or explicitly reject unsupported keys before accepting data; validate with anonymous extra key. Parent decides scope and owns edits/revalidation.

not_findings: No printer-page role restriction matches inspected original; not an admin-policy bug.
Printer setting does not feed or enable physical report print; explicit accepted scope, not a missing connection bug.
Synchronous CUPS enumeration cannot be interrupted and target conditions remain pending; already documented, no new bounded-exit claim.
